_comment: EVERYTHING IN THIS FILE IS SPECIFIC TO ONE INSTITUTION'S INSTALLATION. If you are forking PXL Classroom, this is the file you edit - and apart from secrets it should be the only one. The product name stays 'PXL Classroom': that is the software, not the deployment. Values are read through lib/deployment.mjs, which documents each one. CHANGING A VALUE HERE NEEDS A DEPLOY: the SPA bakes these in at build time, so an edit reaches students only once deploy-frontend.yml has run - its path filter names this file for that reason.
_comment_claim_domains: Email domains a student may claim an address in, when an assignment does not name its own claim_domains. BOTH entries are deliberate: the student domain is the cohort, and the staff domain is what lets a lecturer accept their own assignment to check a link works before handing it to forty people - drop it and self-testing becomes impossible on every domain-restricted assignment. An assignment may narrow this with its own claim_domains, or opt out entirely with an empty list.
_comment_timezone: The timezone assignment dates are DISPLAYED in when an assignment carries no timezone of its own. Display only: every stored instant is UTC with an explicit Z and nothing in the finalize path reads this. It decides what a lecturer and a student see on screen, which for a deadline is worth getting right.
_comment_hub: The GitHub account and repository holding the hub - every workflow lives there, while each course organization holds only data.
_comment_app_slug: The GitHub App slug, as it appears in github.com/apps/<slug>. A fork creates its own App through the SPA's /setup route and puts the slug here. It must be the slug rather than a display name, because it is used to read the App's declared permissions.
_comment_control_repo: The per-organization repository holding a course's data: roster, assignments, acceptances, observations, reports. Always PRIVATE. Renaming this on a running deployment orphans every control repository already created, so it is effectively fixed once any organization has been onboarded.
_comment_archive: Preserved submissions live in <prefix><assignment-id>, one archive per assignment so that retiring a finished cohort is a single repository rather than one shared with every other year. legacy_archive_repo is the single per-organization archive used before that change; it is READ rather than derived, because a submission preserved earlier still lives there. A fork with no history may set it to null.
